# Executive Summary

## Summary
Genesis Compiler Phase 1 is complete.

The runtime architecture is now considered the permanent execution substrate of Genesis.

The runtime foundation is deterministic, immutable, replayable, traceable, and constitutionally governed.

Future compiler phases extend this foundation rather than redesign it.

## Release Nature
This is a governance-only constitutional foundation release. No runtime implementation, test, dependency, schema, CI, or behavior changes are authorized in this package.
